final: WITH j AS (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.timespan, e.fillcount FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault), tif AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS tif_avg FROM j GROUP BY timespan), oa AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS order_avg FROM j GROUP BY ordersmark, timespan), r AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.timespan, oa.order_avg, oa.order_avg - tif.tif_avg AS excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY oa.timespan ORDER BY oa.order_avg DESC) AS rnk FROM oa JOIN tif ON oa.timespan IS tif.timespan WHERE oa.order_avg > tif.tif_avg) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, order_avg, excess, rnk FROM r WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, rnk, ordersmark
